cases.description: Incorrect legacy FI source IDs stay retired and replacement links remain scoped.
23 MW is not upgraded to IT load without an explicit denominator.
Unresolved customer/campus overlap blocks their combined potential.
468 MW thermal backup power never enters electric-load scenarios.
90 MW baseline is source-reported IT capacity.
2023 is first-capacity timing, not proof all 90 MW opened then.
An operational campus retains an undated 60 MW IT increment.
150 MW expansion ceiling does not acquire a full commissioning year.
Available connection remains distinct from installed IT.
200 MW potential cannot subtract an 80 MW available connection as installed capacity.
430 MW headline is not converted with a PUE assumption.
The 1.2 PUE limit is explicitly design and up-to.
2027 first capacity does not date the full 310 MW campus.
No target-year electricity is invented without a deployment schedule.
Verified sources retain original excerpts, languages, locators and attribution.

interpretation: Same-agent reviewed real-source acceptance suite. Not blind, independent, representative or a model accuracy/recall estimate. Model identifier was not exposed. Failed source retrievals remain unknown.
